"""Thread-safe RW lock using threading."""
import threading

class RWLock:
    def __init__(self):
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._cond = threading.Condition(self._lock)
        self._readers = 0
        self._writer = False

    def r_acquire(self):
        with self._lock:
            while self._writer:
                self._cond.wait()
            self._readers += 1

    def r_release(self):
        with self._lock:
            self._readers -= 1
            if self._readers == 0:
                self._cond.notify_all()

    def w_acquire(self):
        with self._lock:
            while self._writer or self._readers > 0:
                self._cond.wait()
            self._writer = True

    def w_release(self):
        with self._lock:
            self._writer = False
            self._cond.notify_all()

def demo():
    rw = RWLock()
    rw.r_acquire()
    rw.r_release()
    return True
